description: This Java source file defines an abstract class providing helper methods for mapping Adaptable objects to Message objects and headers within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods to create messages from adaptables, extract message headers, and get status codes, facilitating message handling and transformation.

classes.name: AbstractMessageMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing static helper methods for mapping Adaptable objects to Messages and headers, supporting message creation, header extraction, and status code retrieval.

methods.name: messageFrom
methods.description: Creates a Message object from the given Adaptable by deserializing headers and payload, including validation of the message.

methods.name: messageHeadersFrom
methods.description: Extracts and constructs MessageHeaders from the given Adaptable, incorporating path and header information.

methods.name: statusCodeFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the HttpStatusCode from the Adaptable's payload, throwing NullPointerException if absent.
